tax.text: Lasher's platform calls for repealing tax cuts for the wealthy and restoring funding to social safety-net programs.
tax.quote: Repeal Trump's tax breaks to the rich and restore devastating cuts to the social safety net.

wages.text: He supports raising and indexing the federal minimum wage and co-sponsoring the PRO Act to make it easier to unionize.
wages.quote: Raise the minimum wage across the nation and index it to inflation.

debt.text: He says he will oppose cuts to Social Security and reject the idea that it drives the federal deficit.
debt.quote: In Congress, I will strongly oppose Republican cuts to Social Security and will push back against the false narrative that Social Security is a driver of the deficit.

housing.text: He wrote New York legislation to expand housing supply and loosen zoning, and pledges to use federal dollars to encourage pro-housing policies.
housing.quote: Leverage federal dollars to spur pro-housing policies at the state and local level.

schools.text: He pledges to oppose dismantling the Department of Education and to reverse federal cuts to public education funding.
schools.quote: Work to reverse federal cuts to education funding across the board.

immigration.text: He calls for abolishing ICE and expanding protections for immigrants.

guns.text: He supports universal background checks and reinstating the assault weapons ban, and sits on Everytown's board.
guns.quote: Vote for universal background checks for all gun sales and transfers.

abortion.text: He pledges to pass the Women's Health Protection Act to restore nationwide abortion rights.
abortion.quote: Fight to pass the Women's Health Protection Act to restore abortion rights nationwide.

health.text: He supports Medicare for All or a similar plan ensuring universal coverage.
health.quote: Push to pass Medicare for All, or a similar plan that ensures universal care.

energy.text: He backs a clean energy transition and holding polluters accountable, and authored a first-in-nation gas ban in new buildings.
energy.quote: Prioritize supporting our clean energy transition and hold big polluters accountable.
